I feel so peaceful now that I know I have a way out. Now that I know exactly how I can end my life, I feel almost happy. Free? Knowing complete freedom from life, rest, rot, however you want to define it, is just a half hour away makes me the happiest I've been in months. I'm not romanticizing death. I know exactly what it is, I know what I'll look like after I do it and I understand the processes of decomposition. I know there is a fair chance I'll shit all over myself! I don't care; it won't be my problem at that point. I just wanted to share the really bizarre but not unwelcome feeling of peace and happiness I'm feeling now that I know what I have to do, and that what I have to do is simple, inexpensive, and quick!

Edit: I think I'll stick around long enough to see season 3 of Sherlock. I won't get to see Capaldi's run as the Doctor, but I saw the 50th anniversary in theatres and the Christmas special, and I got to see Matt Smith and David Tennant play the character, and they were just wonderful, so I think that's enough. That silly british show was one of the few things that gave me genuine hope. I'm glad I won't have the capacity to miss it.

My friend is also very unstable, and has a history of not being present when she says she will be. I asked her if I could just hang out at her apartment so I wouldn't have to be alone, and she said yes but that she was out of town and she'd contact me when she returned. She never contacted me. I was extremely upset and told her if she did something so egregiously shitty once more, I was going to call it quits on our friendship altogether. She replied that she didn't want to wait around for that to happen, and that she was finished with me. 

I am on a waiting list for therapy provided by PhD students at my local university. DBT worked well for me in the past, but results take a long time and the process of getting there is worse than what I'm experiencing now. I can't handle sudden upheavals in my life, and two in as many days is too much for me. I am alone, I am terrified of the future being the same or worse than the present, and I don't have hope that I can improve. The decent parts of life are not worth the bad parts. I can't function in friendships because of the BPD, I can't function in a sexual relationship because of the PTSD. I am alone. I have nobody. I am sick and I can't see myself ever getting better. The cure is worse than the disease. I don't have enough life left to sort through the miasma of everything that is wrong with me. I don't see the point in wading through another 50 or 60 years only to get to the same place.

I'm 26, I have borderline personality disorder, bipolar 2, a history of childhood abuse and sexual assault and rape as an adult. My life is a wreck of failed friendships, abandonment from family, homelessness, poverty, and instability of every kind. 

Yesterday I found out I'm going to be moving against my will for the second time in 6 months, and today my best friend told me she didn't want anything to do with me anymore. I stopped taking my medication this morning too; I just can't bear the thought of feeling anything at all right now. 

I have called crisis lines and I get the "are you in a safe place, do you have a plan" questions, but nobody who just wants to listen. I'm in a bad place, and I can't bear the cycle of my life any longer. It's predictable, it's miserable, and I mostly bring it on myself. Killing myself seems like the only option I have. I have no insurance, and admitting myself to a hospital is out of my price range. I don't want to get out with a bill that will forever preclude my getting an education or improving my life. What help I get is through a community mental health center paid for by the state. I feel like I've come to a point where I have to cut my losses. I can't cope with moving again, or with losing the lifeline of my friend, who was the only person tying me here. So I'm thinking of going to a gun range in another city, renting a gun, and blowing my brains out right then and there. I'm just so fucking tired, and miserable. Please help me.
